theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_graph_projection_nullMeasurableSet
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (L : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclidean N)), 0 ≤ L → (∀ y ∈ A, ∀ z ∈ A, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) → NullMeasurableSet (Grassmannian.project P '' A) (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
